terms.quote: Approximately $5.3B implied equity value and $5.8B implied enterprise value; slide 3: "Transaction Value $5.8B Implied Enterprise Value"
terms.note: The press release's "implied value of $5.8 billion" is the ENTERPRISE value. Bridge: equity $5,318m + RXO debt principal $501m (30-Jun-2026: $400m 6.375% 2031 notes, $65m ABL, $36m finance leases/asset financing/short-term debt) - cash $15m = $5,804m ~ $5.8bn. RXO net debt is therefore ADDED to equity value (operating leases excluded). Merger agreement requires RXO credit facility to be repaid/terminated at close (s.7.15(a)) and RXO to cooperate on redemption/consent solicitation for its senior notes.
